highlights.label: Highlights
highlights.title: Where her work has shown up.

humanExperienceWeek.title: Human Experience Week, Royal North Shore Hospital
humanExperienceWeek.text: Three paintings created with patients, visitors and staff, with Daw Mi painting the backgrounds that connect their stories. Unveiled by the hospital’s General Manager.
humanExperienceWeek.alt: Daw Mi kneeling beside one of the three paintings at Royal North Shore Hospital

artOfWellness.title: The Art of Wellness
artOfWellness.text: Participatory art sessions for patients, carers and staff at Royal North Shore Hospital, part of a NORTH Foundation program.
artOfWellness.alt: A large, colourful group drawing of flowers made during an Art of Wellness session

cecat.title: Published by CECAT
cecat.text: Her diploma essay, “Overcoming Vicarious Trauma & Discovering Self-compassion”, was shared by CECAT’s director, Robert Gray, with three of her artworks. She is also listed in CECAT’s directory of art therapists.
cecat.alt: Daw Mi’s painting of a figure in yellow sketching beneath bare trees, from her CECAT essay
